html:
IS-Net (ECCV 2022, the DIS benchmark's authors): cuts the foreground out of a photo as a fine mask at 1024 x 1024 (background removal); the authors' general-use model and the academic DIS5K one. Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: Highly Accurate Dichotomous Image Segmentation, ECCV 2022, 2022-03-06
  • Original code: https://github.com/xuebinqin/DIS at b6764e20381f
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/xuebinqin/DIS/blob/b6764e20381f6f42a70f83fa3324181529ed1403/LICENSE.md ; https://github.com/xuebinqin/DIS/blob/b6764e20381f6f42a70f83fa3324181529ed1403/README.md
  • Training data: DIS5K (dichotomous image segmentation) (README: the general-use model is "optimized ... for general use" (training data not named); isnet.pth is the academic model trained on DIS5K V1.0 (DIS-TR). DIS5K ships its own terms of use (DIS5K-Dataset-Terms-of-Use.pdf).)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, igev, cutlass_conv
  • Variants: isnet-general-use, isnet
  • Outputs: alpha
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): isnet-general-use 3000x4000 (0.9 GiB peak allocated, 1.0 reserved); isnet 3000x4000 (0.9 GiB peak allocated, 1.0 reserved)
  • isnet-general-use 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 34 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 32 s (ONNX + engine).
  • isnet 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 34 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 34 s (ONNX + engine).
  • isnet-general-use original 1080x1920: xuebinqin/DIS@b6764e20381f, float pre- and post-processing
  • isnet original 1080x1920: xuebinqin/DIS@b6764e20381f, float pre- and post-processing
  • isnet-general-use load / first call: original 1.58 s / 0.407 s, portable 0.24 s / 0.293 s, kernels 1.32 s / 0.087 s
  • isnet load / first call: original 1.58 s / 0.409 s, portable 0.23 s / 0.338 s, kernels 1.54 s / 0.116 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

Each image at its own size against its binary mask: MAE of the alpha, max F-beta (beta^2 = 0.3) over 256 thresholds (BiRefNet's evaluation). Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.002 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.02 and p99 <= 0.25 (absolute error of the output alpha).
